activity.notes: Vučić served as Prime Minister of Serbia from 27 April 2014 until 31 May 2017. As of 2 September 2026 he remains the incumbent President of Serbia, so ATLAS does not fabricate an end date for that current presidency; only this completed premiership is authored.
